scientific_limitations: Only odd primes with 2 primitive modulo the prime square; weights are positive and have t+1 divisible by that prime.
Periodicity is eventual; no initial-period claim for high powers.
Related generalized Fubini congruences from Diagana--Maiga (2017) were located only at abstract level; equivalent statements in unlocated literature remain possible.
title: Sharp \(p\)-adic shift valuations and least periods for colored Fubini polynomials
